description: This file contains utility functions and a trait for resource allocation within Apache Spark, including resource amount calculations, resource address management, and methods for acquiring and releasing resources.

classes.name: ResourceAllocator
classes.description: A trait to help executor/worker allocate resources, designed for single-threaded use, managing resource addresses and their availability.

methods.name: isOneEntireResource
methods.description: Checks if a given resource amount equals the constant ONE_ENTIRE_RESOURCE.

methods.name: toInternalResource
methods.description: Converts a fractional resource amount (Double) to internal Long representation.

methods.name: toFractionalResource
methods.description: Converts an internal Long resource amount back to fractional Double representation.

methods.name: resourcesAmounts
methods.description: Returns a map of resource addresses to their current available amounts.

methods.name: availableAddrs
methods.description: Returns a sorted sequence of resource addresses that are not fully assigned.

methods.name: assignedAddrs
methods.description: Returns a sorted sequence of resource addresses that are currently assigned.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire specified amounts of resources from given addresses, throws exception if unavailable.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases specified amounts of resources back to addresses, throws exception if total exceeds maximum.
